name: Miseria RPG
source:
A visual novel where you embark on an adventure hoping to find the Angel of Mercy as you cross the hostile lands of Miseria. Good luck, adventurer.

[From [url=https://atpprojects.itch.io/miseriarpg]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部视觉小说：穿越Miseria的危险土地，踏上寻找慈悲天使的冒险。

祝你好运，冒险者。

[来源：[url=https://atpprojects.itch.io/miseriarpg]itch.io[/url]]
